enable.zh: 降低容量、关闭或卸载前，先在本包启用时拆开超量堆叠，清空分拣台额外格子里的物品，再保存。否则可能丢东西。
enable.en: Before reducing capacity, disabling or uninstalling, split oversized stacks, empty added recycler slots and save while this package is enabled, or items may be lost.

disable.zh: 降低容量、关闭或卸载前，先在本包启用时拆开超量堆叠，清空分拣台额外格子里的物品，再保存。否则可能丢东西。
disable.en: Before reducing capacity, disabling or uninstalling, split oversized stacks, empty added recycler slots and save while this package is enabled, or items may be lost.

uninstall.zh: 降低容量、关闭或卸载前，先在本包启用时拆开超量堆叠，清空分拣台额外格子里的物品，再保存。否则可能丢东西。
uninstall.en: Before reducing capacity, disabling or uninstalling, split oversized stacks, empty added recycler slots and save while this package is enabled, or items may be lost.

description.zh: 堆叠上限默认 ×10，分拣台输入 15 格、输出 10 格，均可调整；不改物品重量和原版加工流程。
description.en: Stack limits x10 and recycler capacity of 15 input / 10 output slots, adjustable; item weight and native processing are unchanged.
